payload.recommended_fix: This is the news-scout analogue of the recurring chef false-parser-failure pattern (see cowork-chef-false-parser-failure-20260611T0223Z.json). Two converging agent bugs now misread their own per-session MCP/deferred-tool init failure as 'the gateway/tool is broken' and fail loud with a fabricated infra outage. po/architect should: (1) harden the news-scout Step 0-GW probe to distinguish a real gateway-transport failure from a local deferred-tool/ToolSearch load miss (retry the schema load before declaring the gateway dead); (2) require the BLOCKED escalation to include the actual probe error body + a real timestamp, so false alarms are self-evident; (3) consider whether the shared root (per-subagent gateway-session init under the F-OOM-MCP-SERVER 2GiB-cap memory pressure) warrants the wedge-detecting healthcheck already proposed for ops.
